findings.title: Collection-led ecommerce positioning
findings.finding: Public methodology makes product-category intent and collection delivery central.
findings.implication: Lead the interview with how catalog, buyer intent and revenue inform work selection.
findings.evidence: Public audit/build/grow process and collection service.

findings.title: Operator ownership is the role’s organizing principle
findings.finding: The position combines strategy, fulfillment, QA and reporting.
findings.implication: Demonstrate one connected operating loop rather than a list of isolated tactics.

findings.title: Partner scope is worth clarifying
findings.finding: Role partner coordination and public no-blog/no-backlink copy differ.
findings.implication: Ask which account situations justify partner work; do not erase either source.

findings.title: Organic Shopping belongs in the operating model
findings.finding: Founder discusses active feed optimization and title/image testing.
findings.implication: Include Merchant Center quality and commercial measurement, gated by internal access.

findings.title: AI visibility requires experimentation discipline
findings.finding: Founder says lasting AI solutions remain uncertain.
findings.implication: Use repeatable observations and qualified revenue evidence; avoid guaranteed visibility claims.

findings.title: Case results are claims requiring source-system validation
findings.finding: The public case library reports commercial outcomes across several workstreams.
findings.implication: Treat figures as self-reported evidence of positioning, not a causal forecast.
findings.evidence: Public case descriptions; no internal source data accessed.

findings.title: Job availability is not established
findings.finding: Accessible LinkedIn employer description coexists with an empty Gusto board and a gone direct posting.
findings.implication: Use role text to tailor the interview artifact; do not label hiring status verified.
findings.evidence: Direct Gusto posting returned HTTP 410; LinkedIn description accessible.

Its no-blog/no-backlink positioning differs from partner coordination in the role listing. Technical and outcome assertions are SEOasis claims, not independently established facts.

sources.title: Ecom SEO Case Studies | SEOasis
sources.note: Public case library includes collection work, technical hack cleanup, AI referral revenue, organic Shopping, and blog-related results. Statistics are self-reported; baselines and causal attribution require source-system validation.

sources.title: Interview with Mike Sack on organic shopping - Productrise Blog
sources.note: Accessible first-person Q&A with Mike Sack, hosted by a vendor he uses. He discusses boutique delivery, supplemental feeds, images/title experiments, and uncertainty in durable AI tactics. Vendor-hosted results are self-reported.

sources.title: Blog — Ecommerce SEO, AEO & AI Visibility | SEOasis
sources.note: Public article library covers Shopify/ecommerce, AEO, collection strategy and AI recommendations; its existence does not establish client blog deliverable scope.

sources.title: How to Optimize Shopify Sites for Search Engines in 2026 | SEOasis
sources.note: Article attributed to Mike Sack, dated April 30, 2026. Public collection methodology discusses category/modifier research, catalog relevance, URL and structured data.

limitations: Public sources establish positioning and stated responsibilities, not current fulfillment SOPs.
All reported client results are self-reported; attribution and causality unverified.
No private platforms, keyword volumes, rankings or AI visibility metrics were accessed.
No standalone About page was verified; team identities were taken from the live homepage.
No direct founder social account history was exhaustively reviewed.
handoff: Review Organic Shopping interview in L/O workstreams.
Resolve blog/link partner scope with Mike.
Preserve Gusto 410 distinction and cite LinkedIn for current accessible role text.
